name: SCP: November 2010
detailed_description:
Roadmap

SCP November 2010 – Coming Soon to Steam!

Hello, fellow horror fans! 👋

We’re thrilled to announce that SCP: November 2010 will soon be available on Steam. 🎮 Prepare to step into the darkness and experience a terrifying survival horror adventure like no other.

In this game, you’ll find yourself lost in a haunting forest, tasked with collecting hidden plushies while being relentlessly hunted by SCP-173. This terrifying creature moves in the blink of an eye, forcing you to keep it in your line of sight at all times. One slip-up, and it’s game over.

Featuring a realistic bodycam perspective, SCP: November 2010 immerses you in a world of dread and mystery. Explore the forest at night, uncover chilling secrets, and face multiple endings that depend on your choices.

Created with the latest Unreal engine 5 technology, you'll enjoy an immersive horror game with breathtaking graphics.

Are you ready to test your nerves and uncover the secrets of SCP: November 2010?

Make sure to add SCP: November 2010 to your wishlist and follow the page to stay updated on the exact release date, upcoming gameplay reveals, and exclusive behind-the-scenes content.

👉 Add to your Steam Wishlist now!

Thank you for your support—we can’t wait to share this horrifying experience with you all! Stay tuned for more updates.


About the Game

SCP: November 2010

Alone. Hunted. In the darkness. Can you survive SCP-173?

In SCP: November 2010, you are plunged into a dark and ominous forest with one mission: collect all the hidden plushies, avoid the relentless SCP-173, and find a way to escape. But beware—SCP-173 is faster than you can imagine. It moves in the blink of an eye, striking fear into your every step. The only way to survive is to keep it in your line of sight... but how long can you last?

With a realistic bodycam view, a chilling atmosphere, and multiple endings, this survival horror game challenges your nerves and your decision-making in the most terrifying way possible. Explore every shadowy corner of the forest and uncover its secrets, but don’t look away... or SCP-173 will get you.

The Story

It’s November 2010. You find yourself lost in a forest rumored to be home to SCP-173, a deadly and unrelenting entity. With only a flashlight and your wits, you must search for hidden plushies while staying one step ahead of your stalker. Every corner of the forest hides danger, and the tension grows as SCP-173 draws closer. Can you keep it in your sights long enough to escape the nightmare?

Why Play SCP: November 2010?

  • An immersive blend of survival, exploration, and pure terror.

  • A unique bodycam perspective for heightened realism.

  • Replayability through multiple endings and secrets to uncover.

  • A terrifying enemy that will haunt your dreams long after you’ve escaped... if you survive.

Add SCP: November 2010 to your Steam Wishlist today and prepare for the ultimate survival horror experience. Will you make it out alive, or will SCP-173 claim another victim?

Key Features

  • Unreal engine 5 : Experience unparalleled realism with the cutting-edge technology of Unreal Engine 5, powered by Lumen for stunning lighting and global illumination. With DLSS enabled, enjoy enhanced performance and visuals, all while benefiting from extensive game optimization for a smooth and immersive experience.

  • Ultra-realistic bodycam perspective: Experience an immersive and intense gameplay style with a view that heightens the fear and tension.

  • Dark and eerie atmosphere: Navigate a dense, haunted forest where the shadows and sounds will keep you on edge.

  • Relentless enemy – SCP-173: The terrifying statue-like creature is always chasing you. Keep it in sight to survive, but be quick—it’s faster than you think.

  • Slender-inspired gameplay: Collect all the hidden plushies scattered across the forest to unlock your escape, but be prepared for a deadly challenge.

  • Multiple endings: Every decision matters. Uncover different outcomes as you progress and replay to discover them all.

  • Solo survival experience: You are alone, with no one to help or save you. The only way out is through sheer determination and courage.

    Don't wait! Download SCP: November 2010 now and test your courage!

    Stay vigilant... or it will get you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 1600/ Intel I5-6600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 / RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low quality / Lumen Off
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel I7-6800K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 Super / RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Full quality settings / Lumen On
